reason: A web plugin that monitors DeepSeek balance and estimated usage costs while displaying peak/off-peak pricing status and countdowns.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示账户余额、会话与本地每日费用估算，以及峰谷价格状态和切换倒计时。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance, session and browser-local daily cost estimates, plus peak/off-peak pricing status and countdowns in the web interface.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek account balance through the official /user/balance endpoint
Estimates current-session and browser-local daily usage costs
Stores daily cost estimates in browser localStorage
Displays pricing periods and countdowns based on Beijing time
Opens the official DeepSeek pricing page
